title: MARRIAGETOXIN Enters Beast Tamer Arc With New Key Visual and Voice Cast
content: MARRIAGETOXIN anime revealed a new key visual and voice cast for the Beast Tamer Arc, which began with today’s Episode 8. Studio BONES Film is handling the animation production, which premiered on April 3 . Crunchyroll is streaming the anime.

title: The Ribbon Hero Anime Film Reveals Teaser Trailer, Main Cast, August 8 Debut
